payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including hand-crafting templates for predicates and transforming triples into text using trivial templates.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed by hand-crafting templates for each predicate, as seen in the WebNLG dataset where templates were created for all 354 predicates.
The transformation of triples into text was done using trivial templates, which were then ordered, aggregated, and compressed to produce descriptions.
The approach minimizes manual workload while allowing control over the quality of input for subsequent steps, despite producing less fluent outputs.
